blocks.text: switchMap switches to a new inner stream and unsubscribes from the previous one. It is useful when only the newest request matters.
Use a JavaScript or TypeScript project with RxJS 7 installed. Run imports through the project tool. Browser event examples need the stated HTML element. This site does not include RxJS in its runner.

blocks.title: Keep only the latest waiting job

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `map` transforms each RxJS emission and passes on the calculated result.
`switchMap` unsubscribes the previous inner stream when a new source value selects a newer one.
`subscribe` registers a listener. For a stream or store that stays active, keep and use its cleanup handle.

blocks.text: After the wait, only garden is printed. The earlier timer was cancelled by the newer input.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Use switchMap only when cancelling the old work is suitable. Do not use it for writes that must all finish.
